Name: Better Movement
Author: georgetr62
Description:
[b]When using controller: [/b]The D-pad now only changes the direction the player is facing, and does not move the player.

[b]When using keyboard and mouse: [/b]There now exists a new movement mode, which is turned on by default. In this mode, the Move Up key (bound to W by default) moves the player towards the mouse cursor, and the Move Left, Move Down, and Move Right keys (bound to A, S, and D by default, respectively) do nothing. A configurable key can be pressed to toggle between this mode and the default movement method. I generally find that this mode allows for smoother, more natural movement across the map. It feels rather intuitive, since it is similar to how you would play a 3d game, where you generally hold W to walk forward, and use the mouse to change direction. However, I still prefer the default movement method when doing more precise tasks like watering, planting, harvesting, or tilling.

The key to toggle between movement modes is set to Space by default, but this is user configurable. The easiest way to do this is to use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] mod, otherwise you can edit the [font=Courier New]config.json[/font] file manually.

[size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][i](Optional)[/i] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to easily change the toggle key keybind.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into[font=Courier New] Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
